claims.claim: ASRock Rack showed a 48RU Vera Rubin NVL72 at OCP in San Jose with 72 Rubin GPUs, 20.7TB of HBM4, a 5000A busbar and a liquid manifold.
claims.episode_span: a 48RU NVIDIA MGX rack with 72 Rubin GPUs, 20.7TB of HBM4, a 5000A busbar and a liquid manifold
claims.source_title: Liquid-Cooled NVIDIA Servers at the ASRock Rack OCP 2026 Booth
claims.supporting_quote: The XGMRACK-VR/NVL72 is ASRock Rack’s version of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72. It is a 48RU NVIDIA MGX rack with a 5000A busbar and a liquid manifold.

claims.claim: NVIDIA lists the NVL72 rack at 3,600 PFLOPS of sparse NVFP4 inference and 2,520 PFLOPS of dense NVFP4 training, with 288GB of HBM4 per Rubin GPU.
claims.episode_span: 3,600 PFLOPS of NVFP4 inference (sparse) and 2,520 PFLOPS of NVFP4 training (dense)
claims.source_title: Liquid-Cooled NVIDIA Servers at the ASRock Rack OCP 2026 Booth
claims.supporting_quote: NVIDIA lists the full rack at 3,600 PFLOPS of NVFP4 inference (sparse) and 2,520 PFLOPS of NVFP4 training (dense). It has 20.7TB of HBM4, and each Rubin GPU gets 288GB.

claims.claim: The NVL72 rack uses four 110kW power shelves, each with six 18.3kW supplies, and each compute tray has eight 800Gbps ConnectX-9 ports and two 400Gbps BlueField-4 ports.
claims.episode_span: four 3RU shelves rated at 110kW each, using six 18.3kW supplies
claims.source_title: Liquid-Cooled NVIDIA Servers at the ASRock Rack OCP 2026 Booth
claims.supporting_quote: Each shelf is rated at 110kW and uses six 18.3kW PSUs plus bulk capacitors.

claims.claim: A Xeon 6 instance delivered 1.66 times the agent-task throughput of a 5th Gen AMD EPYC instance and 4.5 times an Arm v9.2A instance on a 60-minute, 24-way healthcare benchmark.
claims.episode_span: 1.66 times the normalized agent-task throughput of a 5th Gen AMD EPYC instance and 4.5 times an Arm v9.2A instance
claims.source_title: Agentic AI Performance Boost in Healthcare & Industries
claims.supporting_quote: the Intel Xeon 6 processor-based instance achieved the highest normalized agent-task throughput, delivering 1.66 times the throughput of the 5th Gen AMD EPYC processor-based instance and 4.5 times the throughput of the Arm v9.2A-based instance during the 60-minute evaluation.

claims.claim: Macronix raised 2026 capital expenditure to NT$37.8 billion, and Lin said the latest AI rack uses more than 1,000 NOR flash devices versus about 600 to 800 previously.
claims.episode_span: raised 2026 capital expenditure to NT$37.8 billion
claims.source_title: AI Reshapes Memory Architecture as Macronix Expands Flash Portfolio
claims.supporting_quote: Macronix has also raised its capital expenditure for 2026 to NT$37.8 billion to expand its 12-inch wafer capacity and meet the growing demand for 3D NOR, NAND, eMMC and other products.

claims.claim: Market data cited by EE Times put the memory market above $20 billion in 2025 and near $70 billion in 2026, with NOR, SLC NAND and low-capacity eMMC around $24 billion in 2026.
claims.episode_span: above $20 billion in 2025 and near $70 billion in 2026
claims.source_title: AI Reshapes Memory Architecture as Macronix Expands Flash Portfolio
claims.supporting_quote: Market data indicates that the market surpassed $20 billion in 2025 and is expected to approach $70 billion in 2026.

claims.claim: Musk shared plans for three Colossus 2 halls, each with roughly 220,000 Blackwell GPUs.
claims.episode_span: halls named Macroharder, Minihard and Gun Range, each with roughly 220,000 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
claims.source_title: Elon Musk Rumored To Soften Stance On TSMC For Terafab
claims.supporting_quote: supercomputing halls called Macroharder, Minihard and Gun Range would feature roughly 220,000 of NVIDIA's advanced Blackwell AI GPUs, respectively.

claims.claim: SemiAnalysis says 2027 US data-centre buildout is largely locked in and a prolonged Texas permit freeze is the biggest single risk to 2028.
claims.episode_span: a prolonged Texas permit freeze is now the biggest single risk to 2028
claims.supporting_quote: 2027 is largely locked in. 2028 is less secure: a prolonged Texas permit freeze is now the biggest single risk to the US buildout, and both parties are running on tighter rules

claims.claim: Altman met about 50 Samsung executives in Yongin on Saturday and SK leadership, and no new supply or investment agreements were announced.
claims.episode_span: met about 50 Samsung executives in Yongin on Saturday
claims.source_title: OpenAI seeks crucial partnerships with Samsung and SK amid memory chip supply crisis
claims.supporting_quote: No new agreements were announced following Altman's visit, and neither side confirmed discussions on chip pricing or investment commitments, the report said.

claims.claim: TrendForce forecasts HBM blended average selling price could rise 121 percent in 2027 from 2026; Samsung's 2027 HBM is sold out and SK hynix output through 2029 is effectively committed.
claims.episode_span: HBM's blended average selling price could rise 121 percent in 2027 from 2026
claims.source_title: OpenAI seeks crucial partnerships with Samsung and SK amid memory chip supply crisis
claims.supporting_quote: Research firm TrendForce has forecast that HBM's blended average selling price could rise 121 per cent in 2027 from 2026

claims.claim: OpenAI reportedly secured about $11 billion against a $30 billion target, and the October 2025 Stargate figure of 900,000 DRAM wafer starts a month was not a binding order.
claims.episode_span: about $11 billion in commitments against an initial $30 billion target
claims.source_title: OpenAI seeks crucial partnerships with Samsung and SK amid memory chip supply crisis
claims.supporting_quote: OpenAI, which has reportedly secured around USD 11 billion in commitments against an initial fundraising target of USD 30 billion.

claims.claim: The Wall Street Journal, via International Business Times, reported OpenAI's hoped-for valuation fell to about $1.25 trillion from $1.4 trillion and the raise was cut toward $20 billion.
claims.episode_span: a hoped-for valuation fell to about $1.25 trillion from $1.4 trillion
claims.source_title: Why Sam Altman Suddenly Flew to South Korea?
claims.supporting_quote: OpenAI secured investment commitments of only about $11 billion in its latest fundraising round, despite initially targeting $30 billion. Its hoped-for valuation also fell to about $1.25 trillion from $1.4 trillion.

claims.claim: DigiTimes reports Musk is renegotiating Terafab terms with TSMC including operational control, joint investment and advanced packaging, and C.C. Wei said TSMC would have to run the plants.
claims.episode_span: operational control and joint investment on the table, including advanced packaging
claims.source_title: Elon Musk Rumored To Soften Stance On TSMC For Terafab
claims.supporting_quote: The details suggest that factors such as operational control and joint investment are on the table.

claims.claim: TSMC's cumulative Arizona investment is reported at $265 billion, the first fab is operational, employment is about 3,500 with 2,500 more planned, and nearby industrial vacancy fell from 16 percent to 8 percent.
claims.episode_span: cumulative Arizona investment has reached $265 billion
claims.source_title: TSMC's Arizona Plant Creates Magnet Effect
claims.supporting_quote: This year the company announced an additional $100 billion (approximately NT$3.3 trillion) investment, pushing total Arizona investment to $265 billion.

claims.claim: Gartner figures cited by EE Times put 2026 AI infrastructure spend near $1 trillion and 2027-2030 spend at $6 trillion, with $8.5 trillion of revenue needed through 2030 against at most $3.6 trillion expected, and more than $3.5 trillion exposed to write-downs.
claims.episode_span: spending close to $1 trillion on AI infrastructure in 2026 and another $6 trillion from 2027 through 2030
claims.source_title: Jevons’ Paradox and the Silicon Roadmap
claims.supporting_quote: AI providers will spend close to $1 trillion on infrastructure in 2026 and another $6 trillion between 2027 and 2030.

claims.claim: Epoch AI estimates benchmark-score prices fell about 13 times a year since 2023, and a16z found the H200 renting 143 percent above a six-year straight-line depreciation path as of October 19.
claims.episode_span: fallen by roughly 13 times a year since 2023
claims.source_title: Jevons’ Paradox and the Silicon Roadmap
claims.supporting_quote: Epoch AI estimates that the price of reaching a given benchmark score has fallen by roughly 13 times a year since 2023

claims.claim: Microsoft plans multi-gigawatt Maia deployments from 2027 and claims 40 percent more tokens per megawatt, a figure EE Times says is not independently verified.
claims.episode_span: claiming 40 percent more tokens per megawatt, a figure EE Times says is not independently verified
claims.source_title: Jevons’ Paradox and the Silicon Roadmap
claims.supporting_quote: Microsoft, for instance, plans to scale its own Maia accelerators to multi-gigawatt deployments from 2027, claiming 40% more tokens per megawatt, a figure not yet independently verified.
